scenes.title: The Wedding Banquet
scenes.summary: Max's ex-girlfriend Sasha greets Vika at Claude Monet and asks to book a wedding banquet for thirty guests on Thursday, prompting jealous Vika to lie that the entire week is booked.

scenes.title: Yakutian Fish
scenes.summary: Supplier Timur tries to sell Chef Barinov fish from Yakutia, joking that it looks tired after flying six hours and riding two days on dog sleds, and gives him a free sample.

scenes.title: Meeting the Groom
scenes.summary: Sasha greets Kostya, Denis, and Max in the dining room, announces she is getting married, and points out her fiancé Misha, while Vika jealously orders Max out of the hall.

scenes.title: Banquet for a Hundred People
scenes.summary: After peeking into the reservation logbook and seeing Thursday is completely free, Sasha confronts Vika, who hastily writes down a fake banquet for a hundred people and panics Kostya.

scenes.title: The Truth About Thursday
scenes.summary: German, Kostya, Senya, and Fedya corner Vika in the kitchen over the sudden hundred-person banquet, forcing her to confess that Thursday's event is actually a wedding for thirty.

scenes.title: The Yakutian Diamond
scenes.summary: Lyova brings Chef Barinov a sparkling stone found inside the Yakutian fish; convinced it is smuggled diamonds, Barinov stops Lyova from calling the police and orders all of Timur's fish.

scenes.title: A Scene of Jealousy
scenes.summary: After the cooks tease Max about Sasha, Vika confronts Max for holding Sasha's hands and makes him promise not to talk to her, while Fedya finds a diamond inside his own fish!

scenes.title: Appraising the Stone
scenes.summary: Outside by the delivery van, Barinov tries to buy Fedya's crate of fish before taking the rest of Timur's batch, and Senya tricks Timur into appraising the diamond for a hundred thousand rubles.

scenes.title: Sasha's Nighttime Call
scenes.summary: In the middle of the night, Sasha calls Max in tears because her drunk fiancé Misha wants to drive, while at Arcobaleno Barinov and Lyova find no diamonds and decide to raid Monet's kitchen.

scenes.title: The Sprained-Ankle Cover Story
scenes.summary: At Max's request, Denis calls Vika's phone pretending Kostya sprained his ankle at a bar so Max can borrow Vika's car, and Max wakes Kostya to make him memorize the cover story.

scenes.title: Late-Night Fish Cleaning
scenes.summary: At three in the morning, Barinov and Lyova sneak into Claude Monet to gut Fedya's fish for diamonds, only to catch Senya and Fedya already gutting fifty kilos of fish for the same reason.

scenes.title: The Morning Batch
scenes.summary: Barinov wakes Timur by phone and learns that the afternoon delivery was actually smuggled Norwegian fish rather than the morning Yakutian batch, while Max picks up Denis to go help Sasha.

scenes.title: The Rowdy Groom
scenes.summary: Realizing Max dragged him out at night and made him lie to Vika just to help his ex-girlfriend Sasha, Denis tries to leave, right before Sasha's drunk fiancé Misha attacks them.

scenes.title: The Rescue Operation
scenes.summary: Hearing the brawl outside, Barinov, Senya, Fedya, and Lyova rush out and help Max load drunk Misha into the car; the next morning, when the Yakutian fish has zero diamonds, they agree to pawn their two stones.

scenes.title: The Imaginary Invalid
scenes.summary: At the bar, Vika asks Kostya how his injured leg is feeling; Nastya overhears, thinks Kostya is hiding a broken bone to spare her worry, and orders him to the hospital.

scenes.title: The Secret Club
scenes.summary: After Vika hears Sasha thank Max on the phone for a 'crazy night', Denis, Senya, Fedya, and Chef Barinov all confirm they were there calming Sasha's drunk fiancé, leaving Vika furious at Max's lie.

scenes.title: Glass Marketing
scenes.summary: A pawnshop appraiser tells Barinov his 'diamond' is worthless glass planted by Timur as 'marketing' to sell stale fish, and at Sasha's wedding banquet Vika hands back Sasha's lost earring with a sharp warning.

scenes.title: The Kiss in the Fridge
scenes.summary: Hidden inside the walk-in cooler for the wedding bride-kidnapping game, Sasha confesses to Max that everything was easier with him and kisses him — just as Vika looks through the window.

scenes.title: The Train to St. Petersburg
scenes.summary: With his marriage shattered, Max boards a train to St. Petersburg as Kostya, Nastya, and Chef Barinov see him off, and Barinov urges him not to waste the time he still has left.
